office.en: California Superintendent of Public Instruction, November 3, 2026 general election. Nonpartisan. Certified candidate list, August 27, 2026.

sourceTitle.en: Sonja Shaw for California State Superintendent 2026, “Protect Our Daughters,” retrieved September 29, 2026. The page does not show a publication date.

spectrumNote.en: Nonpartisan ballot line; the statement used here is about girls’ sports

summary.en: Her campaign page says policies that let boys play on girls’ sports teams undermine fairness, and that daughters should not lose opportunities to biological males. No other topic from that page is scored here.

whyIncluded.en: One of the two superintendent candidates. The office is nonpartisan on the certified list. Her campaign page states a position on who competes in girls’ sports. It is not a full left-right platform.
